method: Playwright integration audit across every visible component spec page
assertions: State labels are checked against actual descendant custom-element attributes.
Checkbox unchecked/checked/disabled states expose the expected checked and disabled attributes.
Form disabled-submit state is produced by an invalid required field through sm-form validation.
Menu disabled-option state opens the menu and verifies the disabled option is visible and removed from the tab order.
Every spec page renders at least three component-aware state fixtures.
Dynamic hover/focus states are allowed to share markup because their state change is interaction-driven rather than attribute-driven.
defectsFoundAndFixed: Generic state fallback reused identical markup for Default, Disabled, and Focus.
Checkbox disabled state did not carry disabled and checked states did not carry checked.
Form disabled state was initially modeled with a literal button attribute that sm-form overwrote.
Explicit empty state arrays bypassed the rich state fixture fallback.
